images.name: sheepdog-sim
images.note: Existing native WebGPU production-build capture; house, barn, fences and trees. Full frame, WebP encoding only.

images.name: objekt62
images.source: OBJEKT-62 local production build, Heron-1 VESTNIK home berth at Outpost Dom.
images.note: Native WebGPU capture at 2560×1440. The first-person camera and survey rifle look from the southwest side of VESTNIK’s home berth toward Outpost Dom. The Auger’s pose is staged on the distant dune above the rooftops. The ship and outpost are at their game positions. Full frame downsampled to 1600×900.

images.name: ski-sim-village
images.note: Staged in-engine Village Bend promotional capture. Existing Kiln rail and lamp placed beside the existing chalet, with a shaped snow entry. Source simulation enters a sideways grind; pose settled and paused for capture. HUD hidden. Staging is local only, not a claim that this rail placement is in the released trail. Full frame, WebP encoding only.

images.name: ski-sim-skier
images.note: Native in-game Mutex Ridge menu demonstration. Seed 268 selects a flip with mute grab; the original flight/contact and Jolt determine the crash. Camera downhill of landing, HUD hidden. Full frame, WebP encoding only.

images.name: ski-sim-quarterpipe
images.source: Superpipe finale, capture tick 11259 of the pump-and-pop run (seed 0x5eed), camera looking across the lip toward the grandstand.
images.note: WebGPU Cel gameplay capture at 1600×1000, cropped to 1280×800. Ordinary inputs produced LEFT TRIPLE CORK 1440 + SEATBELT and 30.0M QUARTER PIPE AIR. The selected frame recorded the cork axis and Seatbelt pose 13.

images.name: ski-sim-big-air-tripod
images.source: Big Air K3. Frame 228 (7.60 s) from the locked landing camera in the same gameplay take as the video and GIF.
images.note: WebGPU Cel at 1600×1000. The skier and detached skis tumble past the stationary lift tower after impact. The 1056×660 poster is cropped from (440, 235).
